finding: For any two orthogonal ordinary complex QLS of order n, standardize any actual Q row and its mate's same board row. Fix a coordinate a and form the bipartite graph on all rows and columns whose edges are the Q cells with nonzero a-coordinate. This graph cannot consist of exactly one nontrivial 2x2 component and n-2 singleton components. In particular at order 8 the off-standard-row 7x7 coordinate support graph of any four-family member cannot have positive surplus exactly two: each active coordinate has surplus at least three.
actual_vector_proof: The sole 2x2 component has all four a-coefficients nonzero; each of its two rows carries total squared a-coefficient one. The n-2 singleton components are actual Q=e_a cells. Their mate R rays are mutually orthogonal and are orthogonal to all four mate rays in the 2x2 component by the Q-tensor-R product ONB. Those four R rays therefore lie in a 2D space; their two rows and columns are actual orthonormal pairs. A 2x2 QLS in a 2D space has opposite rays collinear. Q-tensor-R product orthogonality then makes opposite Q rays orthogonal; adjacent Q rays are orthogonal by the original QLS row/column ONBs. The four Q rays are pairwise orthogonal, so Bessel's inequality says the sum of their squared a-coefficients is at most one. The two component rows instead give that sum exactly two, contradiction. No equal-amplitude, reality or support-only realization assumption is used.
budget_consequence: In the 7x7 off-standard-row board each coordinate component is balanced and has minimum degree two unless singleton. Thus positive surplus cannot be one; surplus two forces precisely the single 2x2 component just excluded; any positive surplus is at least three. The four-family per-axis total upper budget remains 21, so four simultaneously active members consume at least 12; this alone does not exclude them. The analogous five-family 14 budget would exclude all five being active on one coordinate, but that conditional arithmetic does not clear original A10/A11 exact inputs.
limits_and_next: This is a written candidate with no disjoint review, parent adoption, formal or numerical certification. Original four-family witness/global alternative, q1/q2/q3/q4, A10 GB15/18 and A11 remain open.
